branding.asset_guidance: Use the dark wordmark on light surfaces and the light wordmark on dark surfaces. Preserve intrinsic aspect ratio; never recolor the supplied logo files.

surface_and_motion.background_treatment: Alternate clean paper and ink-dark full-width bands. Use a faint technical grid texture in the hero background only; keep content unframed.
surface_and_motion.glass_effect: Apply a restrained translucent blur to the floating hero dashboard panels and sticky navigation only; maintain readable contrast.
surface_and_motion.shadows: Use soft, low-spread shadows only to lift dashboard layers from the canvas.
surface_and_motion.micro_interactions: Use short 150-220ms transitions for button, link, accordion, and dashboard hover states. Animate transform and opacity, not layout dimensions.
surface_and_motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and remove nonessential movement.

responsive_behavior.desktop: Use a centered max-width content frame, wide whitespace, two-column hero, and three-column feature grid.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Reduce section gutters and dashboard detail; keep the hero copy before its visual.
responsive_behavior.mobile: Stack all columns, use a menu toggle, keep CTAs full-width when needed, and prevent horizontal overflow.

announcement_bar.text: Meet the faster way to keep customer operations moving.
announcement_bar.visual_directive: Compact, high-contrast full-width strip above the header. Keep the announcement link obvious and the dismiss control keyboard accessible.

navigation.visual_directive: Use a slim, sticky header with a subtle backdrop blur after scroll. Keep navigation unboxed, align links and CTA on one baseline, and use the emblem in the compact mobile header.

transformation.kicker: THE OLD WAY / THE NEXUSAI WAY
transformation.headline: Make the busywork disappear.
transformation.subheadline: Replace scattered workarounds with workflows your whole team can trust.

old_way.title: Copying data between tools
old_way.description: Customer details get re-entered by hand, leaving room for delays and mistakes.

new_way.title: One connected customer record
new_way.description: Keep the right details moving between your CRM, support, and billing tools automatically.

old_way.title: The same request, again and again
old_way.description: Your specialists spend their day on repeatable tasks instead of complex customer needs.

new_way.title: A reliable workflow for every handoff
new_way.description: Automate routine steps and give people a clear path when judgment is needed.

old_way.title: Finding out when something breaks
old_way.description: Issues hide in inboxes and spreadsheets until a customer follows up.

new_way.title: Visibility from trigger to outcome
new_way.description: Track workflow activity, spot exceptions, and know where each task stands.

transformation.visual_directive: Present three aligned comparison rows. Distinguish the old workflow with muted typography and the improved workflow with clear positive emphasis. On small screens, stack each old/new pair without turning the full section into nested cards.

faq.headline: Good questions. Straight answers.

items.question: How does NexusAI pricing work?
items.answer: Plans are based on the capabilities and usage your team needs. You can review current plan details on our pricing page, and our team can help you find the right fit before you commit.

items.question: How do you protect our data?
items.answer: NexusAI is designed with access controls, encrypted data transfer, and workflow activity history. Contact our security team for current documentation and details about the controls available for your plan.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Many teams can connect their first tools and build a simple workflow in a short setup session. The time depends on your systems and process; you can start small and add steps as you learn.

items.question: What support is available?
items.answer: Every plan includes access to product help and setup guidance. Support options and response times vary by plan; our team can walk you through the current details.

faq.interaction_directive: Use a keyboard-operable accordion with clear expanded state, visible focus, and one open answer at a time. Keep answers in the document for search indexing and avoid motion that shifts nearby content abruptly.

final_cta.headline: Give your team its time back.

final_cta.visual_directive: Create a full-width ink-dark closing band with a compact, high-contrast headline, two clear actions, and a short trust-indicator row. Keep the text aligned to the same content grid as the rest of the page.
